## SMBsync+ 2.55-plus.10

- Refreshed the Sync, Activity, and folder pair screens, including their icons and dialogs.
- Made the run button visible on existing folder pairs and corrected the Sync icon direction.
- Kept the app unlocked while moving between its screens; startup protection asks again after leaving the app.
- Simplified Device & app information, with technical details available on request.
- Added **More → Report an issue** for opening this repository's GitHub Issues page.
- Updated the signed Android build to version code 297.

The APK is built and signed by GitHub Actions. It uses the same signing certificate as previous SMBsync+ releases, so it can install over them without removing saved settings.

SMBsync+ is based on [SMBSync2 by Sentaroh](https://github.com/Sentaroh/SMBSync2). Source and license notices remain in this repository.
